recipes.name: Simple Chickpea Frittata
instructions: To a large bowl, add the chickpea flour, kala namak, baking powder, and water. Whisk until smooth.
Add the tomato, zucchini, peas, basil. Mix well.
Heat the oil in a non-stick medium pan over medium heat. Once warm, add the frittata mixture. Cook, fully covered, for 8 to 10 minutes or until the bottom, is golden.
Flip the frittata and cook, covered, for another 5 to 8 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
Serve it with sliced avocado and unsweetened yogurt. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Kala namak, also known as Himalayan black salt, is a salt found in some South Asian cuisines. The sulphur compounds give the salt an egg-like smell and flavour.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days.
